heading: About me
bio: I'm Hyacinth, a social media manager and creative strategist based in General Santos City, Philippines. I started my first business at 13 and was running my own shop by 16, so I learned marketing by doing it for things I owned: taking the product photos, writing the captions, and answering the messages myself.

Since then I've worked with brands in food, fashion, beauty, e-commerce, and software. Most of my work sits between planning and making. I build the content calendar, write the brief or script, then design, edit, and schedule the posts.
I also handle the less visible work that keeps a team moving, like organizing files, tracking deliverables, and keeping product listings up to date.
